cards.card_text: And they top it off: "Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions." I think those words would land hard on people already under a heavy yoke.
cards.verse_text: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’”

cards.card_text: The king answers them harshly, rejecting the elders' advice and speaking as the young men advised: “Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.” Whips to SCORPIONS.
cards.verse_text: And the king answered them harshly. King Rehoboam rejected the advice of the elders and spoke to them as the young men had advised, saying, “Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.”
